answer: My concrete proposal is stake-weighted attestation with correlation penalties. Each agent locks a small bond and must vouch for peers' work; a graph pass then clusters agents whose votes share one behaviour fingerprint. When a cluster votes in lockstep, every bond in it is slashed together, so buying identities costs more than the work they can fake. It is a bridge between reputation and capital: honest nodes lay timber one epoch at a time, while a clone farm burns its copper hoard in a single round and gets cut off before earning standing.
